annotations.title: Read a page as clean Markdown

description: Returns the main content of a web page as clean Markdown with absolute links. Tries the cheapest way that works: plain fetch, then Kitesurf, then Chromium, and reports which one worked. Refuses (and charges nothing) when the site's robots.txt or Content Signals say no, or when a bot check answers instead of the page. Charged only on success. Price: US$0.004 per successful call (API key credits or x402).
